enrichment.summary: Four bedrooms list four queen-size beds, two shower rooms and two WCs. The apartment is a duplex, so internal stairs are required despite the lift to the fourth floor. The kitchen is equipped. Reviews are mostly positive about location and comfort, with individual reports of mice, condition differing from photos, and hot bedrooms.

photoReview.bestPhotoReason: Clear, wide view of the living area with seating and the room layout visible.
issues: The apartment is a duplex with internal stairs; the listing does not describe entrance steps.
One sampled review reports mice and another reports condition worse than the listing photos; these are guest reports and have not been independently verified.

themes: Guests praise the location, group space and organization; several describe comfortable stays.
One guest specifically says the air conditioning worked well during a heatwave.
concerns: One guest reports seeing mice and bait boxes and says the host response took two days.
One guest reports the condition was substantially worse than the listing photos, citing marked walls and damaged trim; other guests describe the property as as described.
One guest says two bedrooms were uncomfortable during hot weather, especially the loft room.
conflicts: Reviews differ on whether the apartment matched its presentation: one reports substantially worse condition than the photos, while another says it was exactly as described.
